name: frontend-audit
description: "Use when reviewing React components, auditing accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, or launch readiness."

# Frontend Audit

1. Read the component and its direct dependencies.
2. Call Front-End Checklist `review_code`.
3. Retrieve relevant rules for confirmed issues.
4. Make focused fixes.
5. Run tests and the production build.
6. Report fixed issues and remaining risks.
